question: How can I generate a Postman collection with example requests and responses for my API?
ground_truth: You can generate a Postman collection full of example requests and responses and publish it to Postman by configuring the postman generator in your fern folder, specifically in the generators.yml file. This feature is available only for Pro and Enterprise plans.

metadata.cited_context: You can generate a Postman collection full of example requests and responses and publish your collection to Postman. The configuration for the postman generator lives in your fern folder, in a file called generators.yml. This feature is available only for the Pro and Enterprise plans.
